name: Viewing Direction Gaussian Splatting
definition: A hybrid rendering model that uses 3D Gaussian distributions to represent the 3D object's shape (position, covariance) and a neural network to encode color and opacity based on viewing direction.
summary: Viewing Direction Gaussian Splatting is a hybrid neural rendering method that uses a neural network to modulate Gaussian opacity based on viewing direction, enabling accurate view-dependent effects without full NeRF ray-marching.
